name: obsidian-gryphon
description: Bring AI to your vault — with guardrails at runtime. (npm workspace root)
author: POLLEO.AI <support@polleo.ai>

scripts.prebuild: npm run build:dist -w @gryphon/protect && npm run build:dist -w @gryphon/provider-config && npm run build:dist -w @gryphon/provider-runtime && npm run build:dist -w @gryphon/plugin
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/protect && tsc -p packages/provider-config && tsc -p packages/provider-runtime && tsc -p packages/plugin
scripts.build:install: npm run build && echo 'Built. Copy main.js + manifest.json + styles.css into your vault .obsidian/plugins/gryphon/ to install.'
